limits: Synthetic 1 MiB/s, same fixture/oracles; not a real provider CPU benchmark.
App PID includes evidence-only SHA audits; their CPU is not separately measured or subtracted.
D before-runs were measured earlier the same day, not interleaved with E; differences are descriptive.
Outside run-scope Apple UI XPC excluded; WindowServer/device GPU not measured in this affected matrix.
CPU percentage of one logical core; sum of process footprints without shared-page deduplication.
Hidden/idle single proofs are descriptive, not comparative gains.
Input->PTY echo->completed draw; not physical/compositor display latency.
Old C long/GPU/native evidence retains its original package and limits; not automatically transferred to E.

fixtureDriftAnalysis.readBatching: D, E and F identical: about 1099 PTY reads/s, 954 bytes/read (P2 did not change batching).
fixtureDriftAnalysis.interpretation: The fixture (same source) spent about 19 percent more user time on the same byte stream in F, also with the unchanged Metal renderer: machine-state drift between sessions (thermal/core placement/background load), not a Loom effect. Non-interleaved D-F app differences carry the same uncertainty.
fixtureDriftAnalysis.metalOutlier: metal-r5 app 48.88 / total 61.24 is an outlier; Metal is development-only (--metal).

productRenderer: Core Graphics; Metal only with the development --metal flag
